title: parseSpellClassLists: Sorcerer cantrip list truncated by column-wrap on real PDF
description:
With loreweaver-qqc landing (parseSpells body-boundary fix), Fire Bolt now extracts as its own record but data.classes is still ["Wizard"] instead of ["Sorcerer","Wizard"].

Root cause is in parseSpellClassLists, not parseSpells. On SRD 5.1 p109 the column-aware extract emits the class-lists region in column order; the right-column 'Ranger Spells' header lands in the middle of Sorcerer's cantrip list:

  9: 'Sorcerer Spells'
  12: 'Cantrips (0 Level)'
  13: 'Raise Dead'      <-- spillover from prior Druid section
  14: 'Acid Splash'     <-- valid Sorcerer cantrip
  15: 'Ranger Spells'   <-- resets currentClass to Ranger, inLevelSubsection=false
  16: 'Chill Touch'     <-- supposed to be Sorcerer cantrip; lost
  17: 'Dancing Lights'  <-- lost
  18: 'Fire Bolt'       <-- lost (this is why fire-bolt.classes drops Sorcerer)

Effect: every Sorcerer cantrip after 'Acid Splash' (alphabetically) is silently dropped from the class index. Likely affects other classes whose lists span column wraps similarly.

Investigation pointers:
- parseSpellClassLists is in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSpells.ts.
- The extractor's column-aware emit is in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/extract.ts (partitionItemsByColumn / bucketItemsIntoRecords).
- One fix path: keep a per-page two-column reading order in parseSpellClassLists (skip class-header lines that appear AFTER a level subsection has already opened for the current class — i.e. don't let a header in the opposite column reset state mid-list).
- Another fix path: detect class-list pages in extract and emit them with a different (row-major) ordering than the column-aware spell-descriptions pages.

Reproduce: npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack on a tree with loreweaver-qqc merged and inspect spell:fire-bolt.data.classes (and any other Sorcerer cantrip).
close_reason: Fixed in branch fix/srd-spell-class-columns-creature-subtype: extract wide-gutter hatch separates single-x spell-list columns (xbh); parseCreatures preserves parenthetical subtype (2ze). Verified against real SRD PDF; full suite green.
